name: Lim Wei Loong
bio:
Lim Wei Loong's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly. After years managing high-end restaurants in Singapore, a chance encounter with a team owner during a private event sparked his interest. Intrigued by the logistics and demands of feeding a racing team, he transitioned into motorsport catering, bringing his meticulous attention to detail and understanding of diverse palates to the paddock.

Lim believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. He prioritizes fresh, nutritious, and regionally-appropriate meals that cater to the specific dietary needs of drivers and crew. His approach is proactive, anticipating potential issues with food sourcing and storage, and developing contingency plans to ensure the team is always fueled for success. What sets Lim apart is his knack for creating a supportive and welcoming atmosphere around meal times, fostering team camaraderie and reducing stress in the high-pressure environment of the racetrack.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Lim has a warm smile and a stocky build.

quirks: Insists on sourcing local ingredients whenever possible, even at international races.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and menu ideas.
Has a habit of humming quietly while preparing food.
